services.desc: Get ready for a quick fishing fix in Panama City that'll have you hooked! Our 3-hour trolling trip is all about chasing down Spanish Mackerel in the bay. It's the perfect way to squeeze in some quality fishing time without eating up your whole day. We kick things off as early as 7 AM, but we're flexible - you tell us when you want to hit the water. From February to May, we're all about giving you a taste of what Panama City fishing is really like. Our captain and crew know these waters like the back of their hand, so you're in for some serious action. Picture this: You're out on the bay, the sun's coming up, and you've got a line in the water.
